tail:
Step-3 review complete for group **b** (batches 5 and 10). Two artifacts written; the closure gate reads my verdicts file.

**Verdicts**

| pair | items | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `lattice-paths-and-catalan-numbers` | 51 A / 16 B | **insufficient** |
| `linear-algebra-methods-in-combinatorics` | 46 / 18 | sufficient |

| `sparse-restricted-subgraphs-and-rodl-nikiforov` | 26 / 11 | sufficient |

No split ordered — no page exceeds 60, and the largest reaches 56 after the additions.

**The two insufficiencies are narrow and both are false declines, not thin mathematics.**

*B5-1* — Motzkin and Schröder were declined as needing CB-15's symbolic method (absent from the spec). But Krattenthaler §10.8 is titled *"Elementary results on Motzkin and Schröder paths"* — verified against the ar5iv rendering of arXiv:1503.05930 — and the harvest's locator (§§10.1–10.4, §10.13) stops four sections short of it. The page's own `lem-first-return-decomposition-of-a-nonempty-dyck-path` plus the published `cor-unique-formal-root-with-constant-one` give both generating functions with nothing new built. 3 items.

*B5-2* — Chung–Feller was declined with "I did not verify the proof closes". The page spends seven items on cycle-lemma machinery and consumes it once. The orbit arithmetic closes exactly: `binom(2n+1,n)·(n+1)/(2n+1) = binom(2n,n)`, so the `C_n` necklaces partition all paths into classes of size `n+1`. 2 items; the Beta must still source the height-profile lemma rather than transcribe my reconstruction.

*B10-1* — `modules-substitution-and-prime-graphs` is backed by two surveys and a paper: **no textbook, monograph or full lecture-note set**, which the source-depth rule requires. The mathematics is unaffected; the backing is not there. The Beta applied the rule correctly on the other three pairs.

**Six repairs applied directly** (all under the step-3 licence; no item added or deleted, no id renamed, no `plan-spec.json` edit): a false witness in `cex-cauchy-davenport-fails-for-a-composite-modulus` (`|A+B|` is 2, not 1 — the counterexample survives); `fs-fisher-inequality-holds-over-the-two-element-field` restated as a proposition rather than a claim about a proof; a wrong common value in `cor-catalan-closed-formula`'s strategy; a missing complement-invariance dep on `cor-the-density-form-and-the-degree-form-…`; the unstated small-`n` case in `thm-a-bounded-partition-into-weakly-restricted-sets`; and a required dictionary step where `cor-a-restricted-set-contains-a-large-stable-set-or-clique` silently moves between the two published definitions of `α` and `ω`.

**Verified rather than trusted:** every constant in the Alon–Pach–Solymosi proof (`β = 1/(2(h₁+1))` makes `1 − β(h₁+1) = 1/2` exactly) and in Nikiforov's; both self-regular trimming lemmas against the published `lem-typical-degrees-in-a-regular-pair`; the declined inclusion-matrix induction (it does lose a unit of range per step — the decline is real); and every Catalan identity and B-page witness in both batches. Dependency sweep: 0 missing, 0 unpublished, 0 `ai-generated` statements, 0 outside the declared closure, 0 B-page citations. `content-policy --manifest-only` and `coverage-checklist` both clean after the edits.

**Routed onward, verified from disk, not repairable in a batch:** the §16.1 GT-1 amendment (bull/E/Bird definitions) is absent from `graphs-walks-and-connectivity`, blocking six later pages of the 393–442 block; `α`/`ω` are defined twice in published content; the real-ceiling amendment is absent. All three are for the lead Alpha and the owner.
